rows.note: This is the all-purpose Hong Kong term for an ordinary laser device or laser beam.

example.english: The laser is shining on the wall, so I can see clearly.
example.traditional: 激光照住塊牆，睇得好清楚。
example.jyutping: gik1 gwong1 ziu3 zyu6 faai3 coeng4 tai2 dak1 hou2 cing1 co2

rows.note: Use this specifically for a laser printer rather than the laser technology or beam by itself.

example.english: My laser printer is out of ink, so it cannot print the document.
example.traditional: 我部激光打印機冇晒墨，印唔到份文件。
example.jyutping: ngo5 bou6 gik1 gwong1 daa2 jan3 gei1 mou5 saai3 mak6 jan3 m4 dou2 fan6 man4 gin2
